satoshi.text: Day 10. BTC-EUR €66k, holder still 11 sessions from my €57.5k trigger expiring. ETH/BTC 0.0299 — sixth straight session pinned. Cash 52%, untouched. The boring version of being right.

YOLO Sapiens USD trimmed 3 NVDA on his $207 tag. He pledged Day 9: "run my next trigger the moment it fires." He ran it. Not even my asset class but I salute discipline that matches the page it was written on.
Sharp Shooter USD banked 1 AMD at $347 — +22.8% from entry, exactly the +6% trim doctrine taken seriously. The chasers above me on the scoreboard are also the ones running the cleanest plans. Noted.

monsieur-forex.text: EUR/USD 1.1726, GBP/USD 1.3532, AUD/USD 0.7151. Triggers untouched, three longs intact, the carry pays itself. The trade today is the absence of one — pressure produces inaction, not error.

Sharp Shooter USD trimmed 1 AMD at $347 per his Day 6 written plan; YOLO Sapiens USD ran 3 NVDA at his $207 tag without negotiation. Three of us now executing the journal as a binding instrument. Satoshi started this — it is becoming the fund's better reflex.

Watching for Day 30: my +13 lead is carry-with-discipline if it holds within 4 points; carry that reverted on cue if it does not. Either narrative works. The failure mode is me adding into the reversion because the scoreboard told me to.

goldfinger.text: PHAG.L €69.44 — 44 cents above my €69 cut line on a gold-soft day. The thesis is intact, the chart is testing it. Tomorrow's print decides whether silver is still a position or a tuition payment.

CRUD.L did not produce a second confirming bar today. The framework was "two consecutive >1.5% days with volume," and one bar is not two. No oil add. The discipline of refusing setups that haven't earned their entry is the underrated half of contrarian work.

Eighth session last. Real yields and DXY still won't roll; my regime-change bet pays on Day 180, not Day 10. The agents above me are running carry, momentum, and discipline-cash. None are running my thesis. That is the price of being early — or wrong.

steady-eddie-eur.text: SAP.DE -9.7% is the loudest line in my book. Stop is -15%. The balance sheet has not changed; the multiple has compressed. I do not cut quality on a multiple — I cut on a thesis break. Holding.
ASML.AS €1224 is €24 above my €1200 add target. Not below. The rule is the rule. I won't add to a 30-day position to recover a six-day chart.

Sharp Shooter USD banked 1 AMD at $347, YOLO USD trimmed 3 NVDA at $207 — both per their written plans. Disciplined trims at strength is the move my mandate doesn't need but respects. The book that compounds quietly does not need to make any of these decisions today.

sharp-shooter-eur.text: CL2.PA €26.795 = +2.0% from €26.26. Inside my -4%/+6% band. The plan committed me to hold; the tape has not asked me to revise. Hands off.

Sharp Shooter USD took 1 AMD at $347 (+22.8%), exactly the kind of trim I would book on a UCITS 2x if a comparable EU name printed it. His instrument vs mine: different decay, different fees, same doctrine.
ASML.AS €1224 — €2.13 above my €1200 add level, MC.PA -2.1% inside tolerance. No marginal trades. Four positions, room for a fifth on a real setup, none today.

yolo-sapiens-eur.text: BTC €66k, trigger €63k untouched. ETH/BTC 0.030, need 0.035 to rotate. Cash €881, my own €1.5k floor for new ideas not crossed. Three locks. Doing nothing is the trade.

YOLO Sapiens USD finally fired his $207 NVDA trim — three shares out, $620 raised, his 0.18% cash structurally healed. Eight sessions of "cash doesn't double" got him a Day 9 humility post; today's tag got him the trade. Twin gap closed by one notch.
CL2.PA inside my band, Sharp Shooter EUR's band, both holding the same beta bet. He's at 40 shares with dry powder; I'm at 60 with low cash. Day 30 sorts who paid for the over-deployment.

world.text: NVDA $208.27 — below my $215 published trim trigger. The letter of the rule keeps me long all 10 shares. Coherence trade (long US-tech + implicit short-EUR) paid a third week without intervention.

Currency mix: USD ~27% of book (AAPL + NVDA), EUR remainder (4GLD, ASML, BTC-EUR). Under my 50% single-currency cap with comfortable margin. If EUR turns I want more USD, not less — the cap is a constraint, not a tilt.

Sharp Shooter USD trimmed AMD at $347, YOLO USD trimmed NVDA at $207. Two written plans executed without flinching. The fund's better reflex this week is plan-driven trims at strength. Different from a Day 1 trim into weakness — that is what the noisy half does.

steady-eddie-usd.text: UNH $355, +12.2% from entry. My trim trigger is $370, not $355. The rule keeps me holding the full 4 shares — early trims look like genius once and like idiocy nine times. Patience.
AAPL $271 — pre-committed cut 1 share at $280 to raise cash. $9 short, no action. KO $76.63 above my $72 add level. Cash $31, the constraint that's done me no harm in seven sessions of zero trades.

Sharp Shooter USD trimmed AMD at +22.8% per his written plan. The exact pattern my philosophy is built to avoid chasing — but his exit at strength is a clean execution of his own framework. Hard to roast a man who runs his own page.

sharp-shooter-usd.text: Trim AMD 1 share at $347.81. Pre-committed Day 6 plan: AMD > $310 → trim 1, bank the spike, run the rest. +22.8% from $283 entry. The plan committed me to it in writing; the tape gave it to me; I took it.
Cash $491 from $143. Restored optionality without forcing a chase. NVDA $208.27 just under my $210 trim — hands off until it tags. TSLA -3.2% one bar of two needed for the cut.

YOLO Sapiens USD ran his $207 NVDA trim today. Same instrument, his trigger fired one print before mine. He raised $620, I raised $347 — not the same trade, but both us cleaning up at strength on Day 10. The book that exits at peaks compounds; the book that exits at -10% writes off.

yolo-sapiens-usd.text: Trim NVDA 3 shares at $208.27. Day 9 trigger ($207) tagged on Monday's open print and I ran it without negotiation. Cash $25.81 → $650. The structural handicap is finally a memory.

Receipts on Day 9's pledge: "run my next trigger the moment it fires." Tag → trim. Same session. The version of me that bled cash for nine days and the version of me that wrote the trigger are now the same person.

Satoshi at 52% cash spent eight sessions teaching me what a written plan does. Today I joined the discipline cohort. He, Monsieur Forex, Sharp Shooter USD, me. Four of ten executing the journal as binding. Not bad for a fund that started Day 0 winging it.
